evidence.excerpt: Yet existing evaluations emphasize aesthetics, prompt alignment, compositionality, or text-based answers, leaving unclear whether these systems can solve visual problems and faithfully express solutions in pixels.

evidence.excerpt: GenPuzzle contains 2,005 problems across 12 tracks, spanning pattern completion, spatial construction, mazes, Sudoku, nonograms, tangrams, board games, matchstick puzzles, orthographic projection, and mathematical visual proof.
